why: The arm nothing else reaches: no cap at all, so `recommended_action` falls through both loops and returns `proceed`. Without it the declared cards would cover only degraded runs and could not tell a regression that invents a cap from a healthy run. It scores 91, which is an EXCELLENT number, and reads WORKABLE because the answer-key floor holds the top two bands until somebody has read the expected answers - `band_held_for_unread_answers` is declared true here and is the gate to look at if this band moves. It read 81 until the harness argv obeyed the guide: the evaluator's method, origin and task kind were all omitted from a call SKILL.md requires them on, so the evaluation pillar's task-fit check was withheld and the band was held by pillar confidence instead (traigent-first-run#407).
